problems.title: The Maze II
problems.notes: Dijkstra where each edge weight is the rolling distance until you hit a wall, not a fixed 1 — the state transition is unusual

problems.title: Number of Restricted Paths From First to Last Node
problems.notes: run Dijkstra from the destination first to get distanceToLastNode, then DP-count strictly-decreasing-distance paths

problems.title: The Time When the Network Becomes Idle
problems.notes: unweighted BFS shortest paths from the master server, then a closed-form simulation of resend timing per node

problems.title: Shortest Path to Get All Keys
problems.notes: BFS over (position, keys-bitmask) state space — locks can only be passed once the matching key bit is set

problems.title: Reachable Nodes In Subdivided Graph
problems.notes: Dijkstra on the original graph first, then account separately for partially-traveled subdivided edges near the frontier

problems.title: Minimum Cost to Reach Destination in Time
problems.notes: Dijkstra/DP over (node, time-used) — a resource-constrained shortest path where cost and time are optimized separately

problems.title: Second Minimum Time to Reach Destination
problems.notes: BFS tracking the two smallest distinct distances per node, plus a traffic-light parity adjustment to convert hops into real time
